info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Payment Initiation Review-spec
info.description: The Payment Initiation Review API facilitates the assessment and approval of payment initiation requests within the banking service. By leveraging this API, financial institutions can manage reviews of payment transactions based on specified parameters, ensuring compliance and security. Typical consumers include banking application developers and compliance teams who need to streamline payment approval processes. The API allows for efficient tracking and management of reviews to enhance the operational workflow of payment services.

post.summary: Initiate a review for the specified payment.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to submit a review for the payment with ID PAY-300045. Once submitted, the review will be processed according to the business rules in place for payment reviews.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a review for the payment initiation process identified by PAY-300045. It contains necessary information to facilitate the review process.
